 Fire alarm communication devices enhance the efficiency of early incident response.
 ANTD.VN - With the motto of proactive prevention, early detection, and timely handling, Firefighting and Rescue Team No. 12 - Fire Prevention and Rescue Police Department - Hanoi City Police is actively promoting and encouraging establishments and businesses to install fire alarm communication equipment. This solution contributes to shortening the time to receive information and improving the efficiency of deploying forces and equipment when incidents occur.
 Báo An ninh Thủ đô • 28/10/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Firefighting and rescue team No. 12 and the Định Công ward authorities, along with representatives from lodging facilities and mixed-use residential and business establishments, signed a contract committing to fire prevention and control measures and the installation of fire alarm communication equipment. Delivering fire alarm information to authorities more quickly. 
 In fire prevention and firefighting, the time it takes to receive information is crucial to the effectiveness of incident response. The sooner a fire is detected and reported, the higher the likelihood of timely firefighting, rescue, and relief efforts, thus minimizing damage to people and property.
 Arising from this requirement, and in conjunction with the implementation of the fire command and control system for receiving, processing, and managing firefighting operations according to the Ministry of Public Security 's plan, the Fire Prevention and Rescue Police Department of Hanoi City Police has intensified its efforts to promote and guide establishments in reporting information and installing fire alarm communication equipment. In particular, the Fire Prevention and Rescue Police force in Area No. 12 has actively monitored the area, directly working with establishments and businesses to disseminate the benefits, provide guidance on implementation, and encourage heads of establishments to proactively participate. 
 Firefighting and Rescue Team No. 12 intensifies fire prevention and control awareness campaigns and promotes the installation of fire alarm communication equipment. According to statistics from the City Police, as of October 20, 2026, 100% of establishments within the deployment area had declared their data. Authorities have successfully persuaded 57,578 establishments to agree to install fire alarm communication devices, of which 6,918 devices have been installed.
 These results demonstrate a shift in the awareness of facilities regarding the application of technology in fire and explosion prevention and response. Instead of relying solely on residents detecting fires and calling to report them, the fire alarm communication system creates an additional channel for receiving information automatically, supporting authorities in grasping the situation more quickly.
 According to its operating mechanism, when the automatic fire alarm system at a facility detects an incident and sends a signal, the communication device can automatically transmit the information to the receiving center according to the connection configuration. This process does not depend entirely on a person directly calling to report the fire.
 This solution is particularly useful in facilities that operate at night, areas with few permanent staff, or during off-peak hours. In these situations, if a fire breaks out but is not detected in time, the risk of fire spreading and damage can increase rapidly. Automatic signal transmission shortens the notification period, allowing authorities to receive information quickly and implement response measures.
 Furthermore, providing complete address, coordinates, and facility information helps the Fire and Rescue Police force to more easily pinpoint the incident location. Based on the provided data, the authorities have more information to determine the distance, select an access route, and deploy appropriate vehicles. 
 Fire alarm communication systems help shorten the "golden time" for fire prevention and control. You may also like In reality, when a fire occurs, the person reporting it may panic, be unfamiliar with the address, or have difficulty pinpointing the exact location. In areas with narrow alleys, unclear addresses, or where the person reporting the fire is simply a passerby, providing information can sometimes be time-consuming. Therefore, accurately declared database data combined with communication equipment can significantly support the process of receiving, verifying, and processing fire reports.
 Another benefit is the ability to communicate remotely. The facility owner or assigned person can receive notifications about fire alarms even when not present at the scene, thereby proactively checking, verifying, and coordinating handling according to procedures. Depending on the system configuration, the equipment also supports monitoring operational status, alerting to connection problems or equipment failures so that the facility can promptly check and rectify issues.
 However, fire alarm communication equipment does not replace the responsibility of inspecting and maintaining the fire protection system, organizing on-site forces, or implementing initial firefighting measures. The effectiveness of the solution depends on accurate data reporting, stable equipment operation, and the facility's adherence to proper coordination procedures when a fire alarm is received.
 From practical experience to effective fire and explosion prevention. 
 Recognizing that direct communication and outreach are crucial measures for implementing technological solutions, the Fire Prevention and Rescue Police Force of Area No. 12 has actively worked with establishments and businesses in the area. The implementation process focused on explaining the features and benefits of the equipment, guiding information reporting, and clarifying the responsibilities of the heads of these organizations in ensuring fire safety. 
 Mr. Dinh Quang Hung - Deputy Head of the Technical and Safety Department - Thanh Tri Power Company Through direct interaction, participating units gain a better understanding of the operating procedures, incident response capabilities, and coordination requirements with authorities when the equipment triggers a signal. This approach helps to address initial concerns, build consensus, and encourage facilities to proactively invest in and improve their safety systems.
 Speaking with officers from Fire and Rescue Team No. 12, Mr. Tran Duc Minh, manager of the Thanh Do Supermarket chain, said that the installation of fire alarm communication equipment has given the unit more peace of mind in fire prevention and rescue work.
 “Since installing the fire alarm communication device, we feel more secure about fire prevention and rescue work at the supermarket. When the installed automatic fire alarm system detects a fire, the communication device will send information to the Fire and Rescue Police Department, helping to shorten the notification time compared to calling the fire department,” Mr. Minh shared.
 According to Mr. Minh, the application of communication equipment also helps facilities improve their awareness of monitoring the status of the fire alarm system, and be more proactive in coordinating responses when unusual situations arise.
 At Thanh Tri Power Company, Mr. Dinh Quang Hung, Deputy Head of the Technical and Safety Department, assessed the equipment as having practical applications and being convenient for monitoring and inspection through a mobile phone application.
 “We tested the device’s functionality immediately after installation. When the automatic fire alarm system is activated, the communication device is immediately triggered. The switchboard contacts the registered phone numbers to check and verify the information. After confirming a real fire, the information is forwarded to the nearest Fire and Rescue Police unit,” Mr. Hung said. 
 You may also like Mr. Tran Duc Minh, Manager of the Thanh Do Supermarket chain, gave positive feedback on the fire alarm communication equipment at his facility. Feedback from facilities indicates that the installation of the equipment not only adds a communication channel for professional firefighters but also contributes to enhancing the responsibility of management units in monitoring and operating the fire protection system. Post-installation inspections and tests also help facilities better understand the signal reception process and coordination in handling incidents.
 For the Fire and Rescue Police Force of Area No. 12, the campaign went beyond simply raising awareness to get facilities to agree to the installation. Officers and soldiers also focused on guiding them to provide accurate information, explaining the operating procedures, and raising awareness of their responsibility to maintain the system during use. These are essential factors for the equipment to function effectively, preventing situations where the installed equipment has inaccurate data or is not regularly inspected and maintained.
 In the coming period, following the directives of the city's police leadership and the leadership of the Fire Prevention and Rescue Police Department, the Fire Prevention and Rescue Police force of Area No. 12 will continue to coordinate with the local government and ward police to implement measures to promote awareness, mobilize, and obtain commitments from agencies and businesses to promote the installation of fire alarm communication equipment; and at the same time guide establishments to strictly comply with reporting, updating information, and maintaining fire safety conditions.
 The integration of automatic fire alarm systems, communication equipment, and fire command and control mechanisms will contribute to improving the ability to detect, report, and handle incidents early. This will gradually build an effective fire alarm information network, promoting the proactive role of facilities and functional forces, aiming to minimize damage from fires and explosions, and protect the lives, health, and property of people and businesses.
